scopeReview: CED FUN-6.B.1–3: antiderivative definition and analytic evaluation F(b)−F(a) for continuous integrands. All finite intervals respect real domains; piecewise |x| is split correctly. Basic previously known derivative formulas identify primitives; no substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions or improper integrals are required.
varietyReview: Polynomial endpoints, positive reciprocal/logarithm, radian cosine, an actual primitive-value table, descending bounds, an invalid whole-interval absolute-value primitive, exponential lower endpoint, cancellation of arbitrary constants, inverse tangent, fractional-power primitive and mixed parity. Ten original-integrand quadrature/table checks complement exact FTC derivations.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
